verdict.rationale: Sentry ships an official MCP server (docs.sentry.io/product/sentry-mcp) with an install command (npx @sentry/ai install) that connects AI assistants/agents like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Grok to search errors, analyze performance, and manage projects, confirmed by a live probe of the docs page and included in pricing tiers as 'MCP access'. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community verification of the MCP server's reliability beyond first-party docs.
